text:
anna_product: @here Quick heads-up — Hosted API: Realtime + Tool-Calling is GA as of today. Major bits: regional low-latency instances (US-WEST-2, EU-CENTRAL-1), stable tool-calling semantics, and a new streaming client with automatic reconnects. Please read the rollout notes below.

omar_eng_runtime: Huge — thanks to everyone who pulled late nights. :tada:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: realtime-service v2.0.0 -> us-west-2 (canary 10%), eu-central-1 (canary 10%)

anna_product: Short summary for product/engineering teams:
- New endpoints: POST /v1/realtime/sessions (websocket/WebRTC) and POST /v1/realtime/stream (SSE)
- Tool-calling: function signatures are now enforced server-side; see docs for the new payload envelope.
- Migration: existing streaming clients will continue to work for 90 days, but we recommend switching to the new client.

dani_devex: Docs link: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/realtime-ga (has code samples for Node/Python + migration guide)

sam_ops: Can we confirm SLA/latency numbers for low-latency instances? Ops needs that for runbooks.

omar_eng_runtime: SLA: 99.9% availability for dedicated low-latency instances. P95 latency target = 35ms for token generation (measured on canonical prompts). Raw numbers in the release notes.

anna_product: Rollout schedule:
- Today: canary 10% in US-WEST-2 & EU-CENTRAL-1
- 48h: ramp to 50% if no regressions
- 7 days: global GA for hosted customers, with opt-in config for low-latency instances

dani_devex: Migration snippet for curl (SSE):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"rwft-realtime-1","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```

anna_product: Quotas & pricing: low-latency instances are a separate SKU. Pricing and quota increases via console — customer success will help for enterprise accounts.

sam_ops: Noted. Also add a runbook step: if we see increased error rate after ramp, auto-fallback to standard hosted endpoint (non-LLI) should trigger. Is that already wired?

omar_eng_runtime: Yes — smart routing will fallback to compatible model variant and standard hosted pool. We log fallback events under route=ll-rollback. Please add alerts on that metric.

deploy-bot: perf-check: realtime v2.0.0 canary perf: p50=22ms, p95=38ms, 0.2% 5xx (canary window)

dani_devex: SDK update: Node v3.4.0 and Python v2.1.0 include automatic reconnect + backpressure handling. Release notes have examples for tool-calling handlers.

anna_product: Action items for teams:
- Product: check prompts against the new function-schema enforcement
- Eng: validate integrations with canary (logs route=ll-canary)
- DevEx: update quickstarts and samples (dani is on it)
- Support/CS: prep FAQ and opt-in enable flow for customers

sam_ops: Will add alerts and update oncall rotation doc.

omar_eng_runtime: If you hit any regressions, ping #eng-runtime and include trace id + route headers. We enabled extra debug sampling for the next 72h.

anna_product: Thanks team — big milestone. Please RT and forward to any external beta customers you’ve been working with. :rocket:
